en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped city park with winding gravel paths, manicured flower beds, and elaborate topiary or large planted urns. Dense trees form the background, with the faint outline of a church spire rising above them. The caption at the top left reads "Leitmeritz. Partie im Stadtpark." and a small publisher's credit is printed along the bottom edge.
